comments: Parametric validation framework reveals transmission trade-offs; reference geometry (36 cm AlF3, 4 cm Fe, 2.6 cm Cd) supports further computational refinement.

model_io.model: Monte Carlo neutron transport through multilayer BSA

hypotheses.hypothesis: AlF3 moderator optimizes epithermal response vs. fast-neutron contamination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AlF3 outperforms paraffin, D2O, polystyrene in epithermal efficiency

title: Gravitational wave detection via massive-particle interferometry
task: Detect gravitational waves using massive-particle quantum interferometry
key_results: Derives frequency-dependent GW-induced phase response; demonstrates tunable detector response over broad frequency range comparable to LIGO band in idealized limit
comments: Proposes distinct complementary approach to GW detection via trajectory-dependent phase accumulation; experimental feasibility and practical sensitivity require further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GW signal is encoded in relative phase of quantum particle trajectories
hypotheses.result: Frequency-dependent response derived theoretically; tabletop detection feasibility suggested
